record: W07-01 selector binding, the argv defect my own writer produced, and its repair

before_binding.meaning: the card's verification command had no handler; that is a non-pass and is reported as one

binding_guards: absent key asserted; no-op re-dump must reproduce the file bytes; every other selector's parsed value identical after; key order append-only (20 -> 21)

defect_i_created.what: the first applied entry ran the WRONG program: argv became ['-X','utf8','tests/ui/continuity/check/main.py','tests/sources/check/main.py'], so the dispatcher executed W13-02's check with an extra argument and the key answered COMMAND_FAILED with no report
defect_i_created.cause: the writer filtered the template's script element by comparing it to os.path.join('tests','ui',...), which yields backslashes on Windows while the registry stores forward slashes; the comparison never matched, so nothing was removed and my path was appended
defect_i_created.class: the shared-registry shadowing the plan warns about, produced by my own append - not by an existing binding
defect_i_created.caught_by: the dispatcher's own result (COMMAND_FAILED, 0 assertions) plus reading the invocation receipt's argv, rather than by trusting the writer's green guards
defect_i_created.repair: argv set to ['-X','utf8','tests/sources/check/main.py'] and verified by re-dispatch
defect_i_created.guard_added: the repair asserts the final argv contains exactly one script element, that it equals the intended path, that no registry path contains a backslash, and that the other 20 keys' parsed values are unchanged (changed keys == ['test.sources.live'])
defect_i_created.lesson: a byte-faithful writer is not enough: the guards must cover the SEMANTICS of the value being appended, not only the file's shape

after_repair.routing_truth_table: local serves only check_id W07-01; W07-02, W07-G02, W07-H07 and case A05 are forwarded verbatim to ops/ci/sources.py (asserted as W0701-ROUTING-TRUTH-TABLE), so this binding cannot shadow the parent gate's rows
after_repair.neighbour_recheck: test.resources --task-id W12 --check-id W12-01 returned PASS after the append (invocation in regression_test_resources_w1201.json)

model_correction: the first version asserted two legitimate cursor outcomes (covered / pending). A transient arXiv failure during the binding run produced a third, equally legitimate outcome: the read failed and nothing moved. The check now models three branches, retries a failing service read up to the plan's two automatic retries, records every attempt, and grades only the invariant 'a covered window requires a complete page'; a wholly refused kind is disclosed as blocked with the endpoint's own message rather than being laundered into a pass or blamed on the product.
state_face: step_state.json and checkpoint.json untouched; the card is not registered and no case (A05/C19) is signed
